mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS dropped by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals strengthening economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates remain low.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.3pp and PAYEMS decrease > 100k month-over-month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3 percentage points and PAYEMS decreased by more than 100k month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening consumer demand coupled with labor market stress, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and broader economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decrease > 2% and UNRATE increase > 0.3pp month-over-month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% and UNRATE increased by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month.
